description: How ETFIQ computes a number, from the methodology page that says so: one page per desk (income, buffer, leverage, crypto, alternatives, themes), flows, scores, categories (how stock and bond funds are placed and which benchmark each is measured against), portfolio look-through, and the ETFIQ benchmarks for model portfolios. Pass topic, the reader's question in their words; the answer names the page, quotes the paragraphs that answer it and gives the page's text. A single fund's own benchmark follows its desk's rule (an income fund's is on the income page), never the model-portfolio benchmarks. Call with no topic for the list of pages.

topic.description: The reader's question, in their words.

name: etfiq_methodology

as_of.description: Date of the newest number in the answer.

citation.description: A ready citation string with the as-of date and the page address.

data.description: The answer, or null when ETFIQ refuses (then error and reason say why).

disclaimer_required.description: True when the answer carries numbers that need the not-advice line.

error.description: Present only on a refusal: what ETFIQ does not publish.

provenance.description: Where each number came from: field, source, as_of, source_uri.

reason.description: Present only on a refusal: why, and what to change.

tried.description: Present only on a refusal: what was looked up.

warnings.description: Caveats to show with the answer.
